You'll receive thorough on-the-job training and complete an official Emergency Response Officer (BHV) course - a one-day session, right here at our location. We're looking for someone who combines that training with good judgment and common sense to keep Via both safe and fun. 
A workday includes: 
 - 
Being the first smiling face guests see (even at 2 AM!)). 
 - 
Checking guests in and out, answering calls, and helping with questions. 
 - 
Giving the lowdown on Amsterdam's must-sees, hidden gems, and can't-miss experiences. 
 - 
Doing security rounds, handling issues, and making detailed reports. 
 - 
Keeping tabs on stock and restocking as needed. 
 - 
Wrapping up front office admin tasks like the night audit. 
 - 
Keeping the lobby looking sharp and welcoming. 
You'll be a great fit if you bring a few of the below with you: 
 - 
Strong hospitality and communication skills - English is a must, and bonus points if you speak another language too! 
 - 
A solid sense of responsibility and ownership - you take pride in what you do.
